BETA Close X Serco Group PLC has executed share repurchases on March 12 and 13, 2026, acquiring a total of 469,933 ordinary shares. The average price paid per share was approximately 321.71 pence, with transactions ranging from 318.20 pence to 325.60 pence. Following these purchases, Serco's total issued ordinary shares, excluding treasury shares, stand at 1,001,590,378, with 1,155,636 shares held in treasury. The total number of voting rights is now 1,001,590,378.
